content.text: serpent was more subtil than any beast, Gen. 3:1 (Moses 4:5). no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, Lev. 17:7. sacrificed unto devils, Deut. 32:17 (1 Cor. 10:20). sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils, Ps. 106:37. rebuke the devourer for your sakes, Mal. 3:11.

wilderness to be tempted of the devil, Matt. 4:1 (Luke 4:2). when the tempter came to him, Matt. 4:3. possessed with devils, Matt. 4:24. in thy name have cast out devils, Matt. 7:22. brought unto him many that were possessed with devils, Matt. 8:16. devils besought him, Matt. 8:31 (Mark 5:12). dumb man possessed with a devil, Matt. 9:32 (Luke 11:14). casteth out devils through the prince of the devils, Matt. 9:34 (12:24; Mark 3:22; Luke 11:15). they say, He hath a devil, Matt. 11:18 (Luke 7:33). if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, Matt. 12:28. my daughter is … vexed with a devil, Matt. 15:22 (Mark 7:26). Jesus rebuked the devil, Matt. 17:18. fire, prepared for the devil and his angels, Matt. 25:41. suffered not the devils to speak, Mark 1:34 (Luke 4:41). power to … cast out devils, Mark 3:15. the devil is gone out of thy daughter, Mark 7:29. we saw one casting out devils in thy name, Mark 9:38 (Luke 9:49). Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils, Mark 16:9. In my name shall they cast out devils, Mark 16:17 (Morm. 9:24; D&C 35:9; 84:67). a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, Luke 4:33. gave them power and authority over all devils, Luke 9:1. devil threw him down, Luke 9:42. if I with the finger of God cast out devils, Luke 11:20. you twelve, and one of you is a devil, John 6:70. Ye are of your father the devil, John 8:44. thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil, John 8:48. He hath a devil, and is mad, John 10:20. prince of this world be cast out, John 12:31. devil having now put into the heart of Judas … to betray him, John 13:2. prince of this world cometh, John 14:30. healing all that were oppressed of the devil, Acts 10:38. god of this world hath blinded the minds, 2 Cor. 4:4. serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, 2 Cor. 11:3. Neither give place to the devil, Eph. 4:27. able to stand against the wiles of the devil, Eph. 6:11. man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition, 2 Thes. 2:3. heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils, 1 Tim. 4:1. recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, 2 Tim. 2:26. power of death, that is, the devil, Heb. 2:14. devils also believe, and tremble, James 2:19. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you, James 4:7. devil, as a roaring lion … seeking whom he may devour, 1 Pet. 5:8. committeth sin is of the devil, 1 Jn. 3:8. angels which kept not their first estate, Jude 1:6. archangel, when contending with the devil, Jude 1:9. devil shall cast some of you into prison, Rev. 2:10. they should not worship devils, Rev. 9:20. dragon fought and his angels, Rev. 12:7. that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, Rev. 12:9 (D&C 76:28). spirits of devils, working miracles, Rev. 16:14. Babylon … is become the habitation of devils, Rev. 18:2. laid hold on … the Devil … and bound him a thousand years, Rev. 20:2. devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire, Rev. 20:10.

people … afflicted … with devils and unclean spirits, 1 Ne. 11:31. led according to the will and captivity of the devil, 2 Ne. 1:18. fallen from heaven … that old serpent, who is the devil, … father of all lies, 2 Ne. 2:18. devil … transformeth himself nigh unto an angel of light, 2 Ne. 9:9. they who are filthy are the devil and his angels, 2 Ne. 9:16. combinations of the devil, 2 Ne. 26:22. deceived by the power of the devil, Jacob 7:18. evil cometh from the devil, Omni 1:25. beware lest … ye list to obey the evil spirit, Mosiah 2:32. he shall cast out devils, Mosiah 3:6. they shall … say that he hath a devil, Mosiah 3:9. devil hath all power … devil an enemy to God, Mosiah 16:5. devil is your shepherd, Alma 5:39. devil will not support his children, Alma 30:60. devil, who is an enemy to all righteousness, Alma 34:23. not be led away by the temptations of the devil, Alma 34:39. chose evil works … devil did enter into them, Alma 40:13. devil would never have power, Alma 48:17. when the devil shall send forth his mighty winds, Hel. 5:12. author of all sin, Hel. 6:30. secret band, whose author is … the evil one, Hel. 8:28. devil … is the father of contention, 3 Ne. 11:29. devil is an enemy unto God, Moro. 7:12.

devil shall have power over his own dominion, D&C 1:35. devil has sought to lay a cunning plan, D&C 10:12. Require not miracles … except casting out devils, D&C 24:13. everlasting fire, prepared for the devil, D&C 29:28. Adam, being tempted of the devil, D&C 29:36. thrust down, and thus came the devil and his angels, D&C 29:37. must needs be that the devil should tempt, D&C 29:39. to reign with the devil and his angels in eternity, D&C 76:44. who shall not be redeemed from the devil, D&C 76:85. wicked one … taketh away light and truth, D&C 93:39. detecting the devil when he appeared as an angel of light, D&C 128:20.
became Satan, yea, even the devil, Moses 4:4. second was angry, and kept not his first estate, Abr. 3:28.
